view.scene_description: A modern, spacious interior with large windows letting in bright daylight. A central spiral bookshelf, glowing shelves, and orange chairs surround tables. A large digital screen displays an image. Stairs with warm lighting ascend to the right. The ceiling has recessed lights and decorative elements. People are seated at tables, suggesting a lounge or reading area.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple circular tiers, each holding books. It is centrally located, illuminated from within, and stands on a polished floor. Its base is integrated into a low wooden platform. No visible supports beyond its own structure.

objects.label: digital screen
objects.observation: A large rectangular screen mounted on a wall, displaying a close-up of a person's face. It is positioned above a wooden shelf unit and behind seating. The screen is framed by purple-lit walls. No visible mounting hardware.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Multiple modern, curved orange chairs arranged around tables. They have metal bases and appear freestanding. Some are partially obscured by other chairs or people. One chair is directly under a table, others are spaced apart.

objects.label: tables
objects.observation: Round tables with dark surfaces, placed among chairs. One table is near the center, another is closer to the stairs. Tables are supported by legs that are mostly obscured. Contacts are with chairs and floor.

objects.label: stairs
objects.observation: A set of wide, yellow-lit stairs ascending to the right. They are bordered by railings and adjacent to a bookshelf. The steps are illuminated from below. No visible supports beyond their own structure.

objects.label: people
objects.observation: Several individuals seated at tables, appearing to read or converse. One person is near the digital screen. Their faces are partially visible. They are seated on chairs and are in contact with tables.

objects.label: bookshelves
objects.observation: Wooden shelves with books, located to the right of the digital screen and along the staircase. Books are visible on the shelves. Shelves are mounted to the wall and appear fixed.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Recessed circular lights embedded in the ceiling, providing ambient illumination. Some are visible along the ceiling’s edge. Lights are recessed into the ceiling surface.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Wide glass windows spanning the left side of the room, allowing natural light. They offer a view of the exterior. Windows are framed by structural beams and are fixed to the building.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000039", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
